1 [[Silver]] | |} == Behavior == When undisturbed, fish tend to stay close to the specific location they spawned at, and generally only swim at certain depths. Note that the depths at which they swim are not always the same as the depths at which the fish can spawn. Fish may sometimes jump out of the water; generally (depending on the type of fish), higher-level fish cannot jump outside of the [[Ocean]] biome. Once hooked on a player's line, fish will cycle back and forth between two states continually, until they are either caught or escape: * When '''struggling''', players consume significantly more stamina when trying to reel them in. The fish will also appear to shake and rotate on the hook while in this state. * When '''idling''', players consume less stamina when reeling in. As soon as a fish is hooked, it will immediately begin struggling. Each struggle phase lasts a random amount of time (depending on the type of the fish), after which it will begin idling. Likewise, every idle phase lasts a random amount of time, after which it will begin struggling again. A fish displayed on an [[Item Stand]] will speak. The phrases spoken by the fish depend on its species. A fish tossed back into a body of water from the player's inventory will return to life. {| class="sortable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" |+ Fish behavior details   ! rowspan="2" | Fish type ! rowspan="2" | Swim

Always try to minimize the distance between the bobber and the player when waiting for a fish to strike. Increasing the [[Fishing]] skill will lessen the effects of stamina drain and increase reeling speed. * Eat high-stamina (yellow) food to maximize stamina. * On a two-minute cooldown, stamina meads can be consumed to replenish stamina and continue reeling in the fish. * While reeling in a fish with the RMB, be prepared to hit the "E" key to grab the fish. Sometimes this can result in "catching" the fish sooner than if relying on reeling alone. This tactic also requires aiming the crosshair at the fish, so careful and sometimes frantic mouse movement is required. * If you want to avoid using a [[Fishing Rod]], you can build a 3x3x1/2 box to catch fish by standing in the box and waiting for fish to jump in. * To preserve fishing bait, you can throw your bobber really close to yourself and then reel it into about 1 or 2 meters. If your spot is close enough to the fish (it is recommended that you use a boat to get close) you will notice fish attempt to bite. Just wait as you would normally do. When you get a catch, you should be able to collect the fish straight from the hook. If not, then continue reeling until it is possible to do so. This will then allow you to catch another fish on the same bobber without using another bait. This also allows you to capture stamina-heavy fish easily due to them being out of the water as soon as you hook them. == Gallery == Pike.png|Washed up Pikes Tuna .png|Washed up Tuna Fishing.png == Notes == * Fish cannot be attacked by players with any weapons, including ooze bombs or unarmed punches. * They can only be caught by hand or with a Fishing Rod. == Achievements == {{Achievement|BigFish}} {{Achievement|GrindFish}} {{Creatures}} [[Category:Fishing]] [[fr:Poisson]] [[ru:Рыба]] [[cs:Ryba]]

'''Hen''' are passive creatures that can only appear when an [[Egg]] hatches. They are the grown stage of [[Chicken]]s.

== Description ==
Hen are tameable birds that can reproduce and will lay eggs under certain conditions, including being fed with any of: {{Item link|Dandelion}}, {{Item link|Beech Seeds}}, {{Item link|Birch Seeds}}, {{Item link|Carrot Seeds}}, {{Item link|Turnip Seeds}}, {{Item link|Onion Seeds}}, or {{Item link|Barley}} (''not'' {{Item link|Barley Flour}}).

== Obtain ==
Hens are grown up chickens. A chicken will grow up after a certain amount of time (approximately two days) after an egg has hatched. [[Egg]]s can be bought for 1500 [[Coins]] from [[Haldor]], or found as loot in [[Sealed Tower|Sealed Towers]].

== Drops ==

{{drop table|stars=0|
{{drop row|item=Feathers|0star=1-2}}
{{drop row|item=Chicken meat|0star=1}}
}}


== Notes ==
* As Hens ''are'' tameable animals, they can be damaged by players ''only'' with a [[Butcher Knife]].
** Despite this, players can indirectly damage both Hens and Chickens by using an [[Obliterator]]'s lightning strike AoE<ref>Chicken Breeder + Bulk Euthaniser

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tw7MIj3wWL4</ref> or by placing [[pufferfish]] in contact with them.
* Hens have 3 different colors: white, brown, white and brown. The probability of each color to appear seems to be 33% each.
* Hens are unique among tameable animals in that they do not directly reproduce a young version; they lay an [[Egg]] instead, which must be warmed near a heat source in order to hatch into a [[Chicken]].

'''Chicken''' are passive creatures that can only appear when an [[Egg]] hatches. They are the infant stage of [[Hen]]s.

==Description==
Chicken are birds that will grow into a hen.

==Obtaining==

To obtain a chicken, an egg must be placed next to a fire or heat source for 30 minutes. The egg must register as "warm" when hovered over.

Eggs can be purchased from [[Haldor]] for 1500 [[Coins]] after defeating [[Yagluth]]. Alternatively, two fed hens can produce an egg.

Two eggs can sometimes also be found in [[Sealed Tower|Sealed Towers]].

==Drops==
{{drop table|stars=0|
{{drop row|item=Feathers|0star=50%}}
{{drop row|item=Chicken meat|0star=25%}}
}}

== Notes ==
* As chickens are tameable animals, they can be directly damaged by players only with a [[Butcher Knife]].
** However, chickens spawned in via [[Console Commands]] are considered hostile, run away from players, ''can'' be damaged regularly by players, and ''cannot'' be damaged with a butcher knife.
*** This is the same with other baby animals, such as [[Boar|Boars]] and [[Wolf|Wolves]].

'''Hive''' is a [[Creatures|boss]] resembling a retextured, upgraded version of [[Bonemass]]. It can only be spawned via [[Developer console|Console Commands]]. 

Hive deals [[Damage#Spirit|Spirit damage]] instead of [[Damage#Poison|Poison damage]] with its attacks, spawns [[Mistlands]]-related minions, and drops items similar to what [[The Queen]] drops. It could be an incomplete placeholder boss for the Mistlands, which was eventually replaced with [[The Queen]].

== Attacks and abilities ==

=== Melee ===
A close-range swipe at a player.

=== Area of Effect ===
Hive will charge up with a thick green cloud before releasing a wave of ooze. This is signaled when he leans backwards.

=== Spawn ===
At intervals, Hive will reach into his armpit to throw out a glob of goop. This is never directed at a player, and will spawn up to four random monsters ( [[Seeker|Seekers]] and/or [[Tick|Ticks]]) where it lands. No more of a creature type will be spawned once eight of that type are already present.

=== Ranged ===
A ranged attack (it is unclear what it looks like in action). It has a 30 meter range. [[Bonemass]] does not have an analogue to this attack.

== Notes ==
* Despite visually resembling a red Bonemass, Hive is probably an unused [[The Queen|Mistlands Boss]] since its spawns and drops are Mistlands creatures/items.
